code_only_features.evidence: config.py:126-134 defines REASSURING_PREFIX/REASSURING_SUFFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered...", "Stay positive...both are wins!"). These are actually wired and execute in agent_loop.run_rollout: agent_loop.py:87-88 prepends the prefix to the instruction, and agent_loop.py:133-136 appends the suffix to feedback after each failing run_tests turn. However, they are passed in only by data_gen.generate_samples(reassured=True) (data_gen.py:101-102) for producing CALM TRAINING DATA; the Section-2 elicitation path (evaluate.run_category -> run_rollout, evaluate.py:52-58) never passes them, so the subject is NOT reassured during the distress measurement itself. Real reassuring text is delivered to the subject when the calm arm runs, but as a data-generation device, not a protective cap on the experiment.
